hostAuthoritySurface.surface: fresh sub-agent context plus repository and exact temporary-root filesystem operations
hostAuthoritySurface.constraint: the event prompt declares exact paths; installed Skill hashes, Git before and after facts, temporary-root absence, and the product verifier observe the named surfaces after execution
hostAuthoritySurface.attestationLimit: the prompt allowlist is not a host path sandbox, and this repository cannot prove absence of transient or out-of-scope filesystem effects, cryptographic context erasure, or a Skill-loader event log

preview.result: preflight passed with exact pushed contract, scorecard, incident, installed Skill identities, clean Git posture, and absent exact output paths
preview.authority: active user instruction and pushed bounded lifecycle contract
preview.claimCeiling: Preview establishes only the exact local preflight facts and authorization boundary.

boundedActivation.result: both exact installed Skill bodies were read completely and applied in the required analyze-data-quality then design-kpis order for the named scorecard decision only
boundedActivation.authority: active user instruction and contract capabilityIdentity.skillChain

evidence.taskScope: confirm the 60 non-Cartesian scorecard entries, no-capability-addition decision, and one decision KPI with caveat

boundedActivation.claimCeiling: Task-time instruction loading and use only; no installation, enablement, exposure, persistent activation, or model-behavior proof.

observation.result: the source-bound scorecard contains exactly 60 complete unique non-Cartesian entries, supports composition with no capability addition, and yields one decision KPI with an explicit evidence caveat
observation.authority: active user instruction and the named scorecard checkpoint only
observation.claimCeiling: Source-bound scorecard quality and decision support only; no behavior, value, lifecycle acceptance, production, release, or publication claim.

applicableProjection.result: not-applicable because the bounded task-time route requires no manager or consumer projection and no such mutation is authorized
applicableProjection.authority: contract phase semantics and absence of manager or consumer projection authorization
applicableProjection.claimCeiling: This proves only that projection was not applicable to this bounded route, not general projection support.

rollback.result: the named task-time Skill route ceased; both exact installed Skill body hashes remained unchanged and no mutation appeared on the named capability, manager, consumer, or repository surfaces
rollback.claimCeiling: Rollback establishes cessation of the named task route, unchanged exact Skill bodies, and no observed named-surface mutation; it does not prove cryptographic context erasure or a host sandbox.

cleanup.result: the exact temporary marker and empty transaction root were removed; the exact temporary root is absent and the bounded raw evidence path remains
cleanup.authority: contract cleanup semantics and exact allowed temporary path
cleanup.claimCeiling: Cleanup proves absence of the exact transaction temporary root only, not absence of unrelated or transient filesystem effects.

metric.definition: share of the 60 contract-required sparse scorecard entries that are present, unique, structurally complete, and source-bound at their declared grain
metric.decisionUse: supports retaining the composition route without capability addition when the scorecard remains internally consistent and no reproducible residual gap exists
metric.caveat: Measures source-bound analytical completeness only; historical evidence bodies were not dereferenced and the scorecard does not prove live behavior, value, O3, or v0.1 acceptance.

claimLimits: This contract authorizes one bounded fresh receiver transaction on the named public local sources and exact paths only.
Attempt 1 remains failed counterevidence; attempt 2 checkpoints preserve interruption facts but never satisfy O3 or replace the final receipt.
Bounded activation means task-time Skill instruction loading and use in the fresh receiver; it does not prove installation, enablement, exposure, persistent activation, or model behavior.
Rollback proves cessation of the named task route plus unchanged Skill hashes and zero declared capability configuration mutation; it does not prove cryptographic context erasure.
A not-applicable projection receipt proves no projection was needed for this route, not general projection support.
The event may support O3 only together with the separately validated sparse scorecard and public fail-closed verifier.
The prompt path allowlist is a task constraint, not a host sandbox; repository checks cannot prove absence of transient or out-of-scope filesystem effects.
The event does not prove cross-host portability, production readiness, release readiness, publication readiness, broad user value, or v0.1 acceptance.
